The votes received by candidates in a class election are: Aarav 22, Diya 25, Kabir 25, Meera 23.
Write a Python program to draw a bar chart in orange colour; add a suitable title and axis labels.
items.answer:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
x = ['Aarav', 'Diya', 'Kabir', 'Meera']

Study the extract below and answer the questions.
"Bus topology needs less cable than star topology. Mesh topology provides alternative paths for data. Tree topology is suitable for networks that are spread over several floors or departments. In star topology a fault in one cable affects only one node."
(i) Explain the term 'tree topology', which is related to the theme of the extract. (1)
(ii) Using the extract and your own knowledge, explain the following: Mesh topology is highly reliable. (1)
(iii) A student concludes: "In star topology all computers share a single cable." Use your knowledge of the chapter to evaluate this conclusion. (2)
items.answer: (i) A hierarchical layout formed by connecting several star networks to a bus or main switch. (ii) If one link fails, data can travel through another path. (iii) The conclusion is wrong: Each computer has its own cable to the central device.

items.stem: The maximum temperatures (°C) of Patna and Nagpur from Monday to Friday are [33, 26, 27, 42, 34] and [27, 30, 43, 28, 27]. Write a program to plot both on the same chart: Patna as a yellow line with circle markers and Nagpur as a black dashed line with diamond markers; add the title "Temperature Comparison", axis labels "Day" and "Temperature", a legend, and save the chart as temp.png.
items.answer:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
days = ['Mon', 'Tue', 'Wed', 'Thu', 'Fri']
plt.plot(days, [33, 26, 27, 42, 34], color='yellow', marker='o', label='Patna')
plt.plot(days, [27, 30, 43, 28, 27], color='black', linestyle='--', marker='D', label='Nagpur')
plt.title('Temperature Comparison')
plt.xlabel('Day')
plt.ylabel('Temperature')
plt.legend()
plt.savefig('temp.png')
plt.show()
items.markingKey: 5 marks: import and data 1, two plot() calls with styles and labels 2, title and axis labels 1, legend and savefig 1.
